dedupe_keys.name: chesapeake bay vertical land motion gps campaign 2019

description: The Chesapeake Bay GNSS team releases GPS campaign files for measuring vertical land motion in 2019. The public Zenodo deposit is CC BY 4.0 and its file manifest names the campaign archive with supporting station logs. Coverage is the Chesapeake Bay region during the 2019 survey. The article explains that RINEX 2.11 observations can help estimate land-motion contributions to relative sea-level change around the bay. Coastal infrastructure modellers can use station trends as a calibration check for subsidence and inundation exposure scenarios. A caveat is that one campaign cannot alone establish a long-term rate; antenna setup, reference frame and repeated observations matter. The 2020 campaign is a separate DOI and should not be silently merged into this archive. I read the own Zenodo metadata and article Data Records without downloading RINEX files, running geodetic processing or fitting a vertical-motion model. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
